in_marathi.name: Sahaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sahaj means natural or simple. It is derived from the Sanskrit word asahaj which means not affected by the external environment. It is a name that evokes a sense of peace and tranquility, and is often given to children who are believed to possess a strong and pure spirit.
